---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new card, feature, or improvement
title: '[Feature] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## What problem does this solve?
Describe the daily HA usage scenario where this would help you.

## Proposed solution
What would the feature look like? A new card? A new config option on an existing card? An interaction pattern?

## Visual reference (if applicable)
Sketches, mockups, or references to existing cards that capture the direction.

## Considered alternatives
What other approaches did you consider? Why is this one better?

## Fit with Monolith aesthetic
Layr has strong opinions about visual identity (see README → Design Philosophy). How does your request fit?

## Premium vs Free
Is this something that might belong in the Premium tier? Why or why not?

## Additional context
Anything else that helps me understand the request.
